AD-R01.speaker: CAPITANUL
AD-R01.text: Welcome aboard. Beyond Earth are worlds we know almost nothing about. What can we bring back?

AD-R02.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R02.text: Each half-tablet has an instrument, two energy units and one archive slot. These resources aren't shared.

AD-R03.speaker: CAPITANUL
AD-R03.text: First, measure. Then decide whether to intervene. Finally, choose which document to send onward. There isn't room for everything.

AD-R04.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R04.text: You can work, or you can watch. The instruments will wait. The controls remain yours.

AD-R05.speaker: CAPITANUL
AD-R05.text: Navigation, hold course. Prepare your instruments. Soon, Earth will lose sight of us.

AD-R06.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R06.text: Ten channels are ready. Each follows something different: an outline, a resource cost, a change.

AD-R07.speaker: CAPITANUL
AD-R07.text: We can't stop the journey for every question. We'll have to choose where to look more closely.

AD-R08.speaker: LUMINA
AD-R08.text: From far away, I seem smooth all over. Bring your instrument close to one spot, and you lose the whole.

AD-R09.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R09.text: A broad observation costs one unit. A detailed one costs two. What you save can protect the probe at our next stop.

AD-R10.speaker: CAPITANUL
AD-R10.text: Look at the object on your tablet. How much of it do you want to investigate? Adjust your instrument.

AD-R11.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R11.text: The reading is complete. Your screen shows what you kept and the energy left in reserve.

AD-R12.speaker: LUMINA
AD-R12.text: Keep the edges beside every image. They mark the beginning of what you haven't seen.

AD-R13.speaker: NATURA
AD-R13.text: Your instruments are in my region now. A particle cloud will cross them. Watch it pass, or shelter your probe.

AD-R14.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R14.text: Shelter costs one unit and leaves three seconds without a reading. Without it, the reading is complete, but noisy.

AD-R15.speaker: CAPITANUL
AD-R15.text: The cloud is approaching the probe. Check your reserve. An interrupted reading and a noisy one don't tell the same story.

AD-R16.speaker: NATURA
AD-R16.text: You can close the probe's eye for a moment. Or leave it open through the cloud.

AD-R17.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R17.text: The cloud has passed. If you kept a recording, the screen also shows your command.

AD-R18.speaker: CAPITANUL
AD-R18.text: We keep the gaps without data too. Otherwise, the next crew may mistake the instrument's silence for the world's silence.

AD-R19.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
AD-R19.text: I can keep everything aboard. But each channel sends just one document home. Which one will represent your expedition?

AD-R20.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R20.text: Your tablet shows what you kept: an observation, a probe report, or an empty space. Each tells a different story.

AD-R21.speaker: CAPITANUL
AD-R21.text: Those who follow us will see the documents before they see the worlds. Choose what would help them most.

AD-R22.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R22.text: Every instrument has something to send. Look at the documents and choose one. Or leave the space empty.

AD-R23.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R23.text: Some instruments have nothing to send. Where there are documents, choose one. Or leave the space empty.

AD-R24.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
AD-R24.text: I'll put your chosen documents in the return package. The rest stay in the ship's memory.

AD-R25.speaker: CAPITANUL
AD-R25.text: Keep the empty spaces visible too. Perhaps that's where the next expedition begins.

AD-R26.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R26.text: The transmission is ready. The instruments can rest. We're beginning the crossing.

AD-R27.speaker: CAPITANUL
AD-R27.text: Somewhere beyond this passage is home. I'm trying to remember how big it seemed the day we left.

v4-saturn-01.speaker: CAPITANUL
v4-saturn-01.text: Look at the rings! It's Saturn. We're back in the Solar System. From here, we know the way home.

v4-saturn-02.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v4-saturn-02.text: From a distance, the rings look solid. Up close, they're countless pieces of ice and rock. Each one orbits Saturn.

v4-saturn-03.speaker: CAPITANUL
v4-saturn-03.text: We leave Saturn behind. Our next stop is a world of oceans, clouds and people waiting for us.

AD-R28.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R28.text: Earth, ahead. I'm opening the return link and preparing your choices.

AD-R29.speaker: LUMINA
AD-R29.text: Say how wide your view was, too. A narrow image isn't the whole world.

AD-R30.speaker: NATURA
AD-R30.text: Keep the probe's trace beside the reading. Your instrument passed through my world too.

AD-R31.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
AD-R31.text: The ship's memory stays open. What's missing keeps its place, until another journey.

AD-R32.speaker: CAPITANUL
AD-R32.text: We've watched three worlds without exhausting their mysteries. Now comes the world we thought we knew completely.

AD-R33.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R33.text: The Earth link is open. Here is what our expedition is bringing back.

AD-R34.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R34.text: The transmission brings two views together: what you saw, and the probe's traces. The next crew can read them together.

AD-R35.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R35.text: You sent one type of document. Through it, the next crew will look back at our journey.

AD-R36.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R36.text: No documents are going to Earth. What we gathered stays in the ship's memory. The journey can begin again.

AD-R37.speaker: CAPITANUL
AD-R37.text: Here is our expedition's collection. What we chose to keep may begin another journey, for someone else.

AD-R38.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R38.text: Ten slots, ten documents. The transmission is complete. And the worlds still have so much to show us.

AD-R39.speaker: AVATAR_AI
AD-R39.text: There are empty spaces in the transmission. We'll leave them that way. The next journey has its own questions.

AD-R40.speaker: CAPITANUL
AD-R40.text: From here, our journey may begin someone else's. Thank you, crew. Stay at your stations. Your guide will tell you when to stand up.
